handbook.what: What the microphone is actually giving us below this level: how many learners have any mic-derived data at all, and for those who do, how the pause the app leaves them to speak in is settling, and how they sound when they speak.
handbook.where: The **Voice and pause** section at the bottom of any level's insights page.
how: Open a level and tap **See insights**.
Scroll past the rate comparison to the voice section.
Read the uptake figure first — it is how many learners this is based on.
Open a class or a learner within it to see the same reading at a smaller scope.
handbook.note: A learner with no microphone data is absent from these figures rather than counted as a zero, so the denominator is always stated.
